inputs.text: You know this talk of a split in the party is just more staged drama from the hidden elites pulling the strings. Angus Taylor has shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for the Liberals to be “open-minded” to increasing taxes on gas companies and winding back concessions for property investors, all to keep the real power structures intact. It’s not any clash of philosophies with the opposition leader and his most likely future rival but coordinated control to protect their interests. The opposition leader also refused to repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump or say whether he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran, which is the classic sign they’re all aligned on the same manipulated narrative.
